subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to wear the offered armor.
source_quote: Daz refused, saying armor would only slow him down

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled the Giants eating prisoners who tried to steal rather than escape.
source_quote: He remembered how the Giants ate the ones who tried to steal

subject: Stool's home
fact: Stool wants to return home, but the location of his home is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Stool just wanted to go home

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin refused the offer made by Zuggtomy.
source_quote: Thorin refused

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes the Duergar mistakenly equate dragon scale color with morality.
source_quote: The Duergar of this city seem to live under the misconception that the color of a dragon’s scales has anything to do with its perspective and morality and choices

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed the poster describing the Ember Vanguard with a spelling and grammar mistake.
source_quote: I notice behind him a poster that says, “The Ember Vanguard, wanted dead as long as we can raise them or aliave.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observed that the picture of the Ember Vanguard does not resemble him.
source_quote: The picture of the Ember Vanguard, most certainly, doesn’t look like us.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed the Duergar guard misidentify him as not red.
source_quote: Finally, he stops in front of Zalthir, “And you are not red.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw the Duergar point to the Ember Vanguard poster and say, “the Ember Vanguard.”
source_quote: and points at the picture of the Ember Vanguard, “the Ember Vanguard.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir heard Grygum whisper about invisible guards in the hallway.
source_quote: Grygum whispers to me, “There are at least five more invisible guards we can’t see in this hallway.”

subject: Grogluk
fact: Grogluk’s defiant and proud demeanor is an act; he’s not alone.
source_quote: Grogluk’s defiant and proud demeanor is an act. He’s not alone. He just pretends to be.

subject: Grogluk
fact: Grogluk works for the Deepking.
source_quote: This Duergar works for the Deepking.

subject: Grogluk
fact: Grogluk demanded proof that Zalthir is not the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: Show me proof that you are not the Ember Vanguard!

subject: Grogluk
fact: Grogluk asked for the secret message of the Stone Guard or for weapons and magic items to be laid down.
source_quote: lay down your weapons and magic items for inspection or speak the secret message of the stone guard.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum performed the seventeen steps of the night prayer to the Platinum God perfectly.
source_quote: I perform the ritual perfectly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, “Fuck those guys,” about the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: “Fuck those guys,” I add with emphasis.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum gave Grogluk 20 gold as a bribe.
source_quote: I size him up and give him 20 gold.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed another grey-skinned Duergar leaning against the wall, eyeing them with cold calculation.
source_quote: I notice another grey-skinned duergar, leaning against the wall, eyeing us with cold calculation.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz paid a Duergar a gold piece to avoid suspicion.
source_quote: The Duergar sticks out his hand and demands a gold piece, and we pay him off.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked the stone giant about a route to the surface world.
source_quote: I ask him about a route to the surface world.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was asked by Gartokkar how he survived the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: How did you manage to survive them?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin replied, “We appeared small and insignificant.”
source_quote: “We appeared small and insignificant.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembered they never had a deal with Thermebechaude.
source_quote: I remember that we had a deal with Thermbechaude. And then I remember, Thermebechaude thought he had an agreement with us. We never had a deal with him.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin killed five Derro after they accused them of being the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: A few moments later, there are five dead Derro.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin found a note from the Gray Ghosts identifying the party as the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: To all - The Deepking’s agents—the four shadows, The Ember Vanguard, who walk among us, wielding dark magic and unmatched skill—have brought death and dishonor to our kin.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum told Gartokkar he knows little about chromatic dragons beyond that they become evil.
source_quote: I know very little other than it will become evil.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum announced, “Yes, we have the egg and it is glorious!”
source_quote: “Yes, we have the egg and it is glorious!”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin unbuckled his belt and his pants fell during Jimjar’s bet.
source_quote: Thorin takes the bet and accidentally unbuckles his belt, and his pants fall.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw the Duergar guard say, “You are a Drow.”
source_quote: The guard scrutinizes me, and the rest of our group, and declares, smugly, “You are a Drow.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir heard the guard say, “You are a dwarf and you are an orc!”
source_quote: Turning to Thorin, then Grygum he says, “You are a dwarf and you are an orc!”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, “He’s good at identifying species.”
source_quote: Grygum turns to me and says, “He’s good at identifying species.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw the Duergar sigh and say, “Then you must not be,” referring to his color.
source_quote: The Duergar sighs, “Then you must not be,” and points at the picture of the Ember Vanguard

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed the walls covered in a faint sheen of dust.
source_quote: I look past the guard and stare at the wall. The walls are covered in a faint sheen of dust.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir heard the sound of armor clanking and saw shadows of visible Duergar on the walls.
source_quote: On the walls, I can hear the sound of armor clanking and see the shadows of visible Duergar.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized the checkpoint was a gauntlet where power, politics, and peril converge.
source_quote: This is no mere checkpoint. It’s a gauntlet where power, politics, and peril converge.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw the Duergar guard point to the Ember Vanguard poster and say, “Grogluk will wish to speak to you.”
source_quote: Grogluk will wish to speak to you. Follow me.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw the Duergar’s crude pendant shaped like a clenched fist.
source_quote: around his neck is a crude pendant. It’s a familiar token of the Underdark, a clenched fist that expresses loyalty to the ruler.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw Grogluk smile and say, “If you are innocent, lay down your weapons and magic items for inspection.”
source_quote: If you are innocent, lay down your weapons and magic items for inspection or speak the secret message of the stone guard.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw Grogluk chuckle at the thought of a gold dragonborne causing havoc.
source_quote: Grogluk chuckles at the thought, a gold dragonborne causing so much havoc.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw Grogluk say, “Passes can be forged.”
source_quote: Passes can be forged.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir saw the Duergar mutter, “Grogluk will wish to speak to you.”
source_quote: Grogluk will wish to speak to you. Follow me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz whispered to Zalthir, “I have seen so many guards of despotic rulers living among the Drow, and they all want the same thing, a bribe.”
source_quote: Daz whispers to me, “I have seen so many guards of despotic rulers living among the Drow, and they all want the same thing, a bribe.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Duergar who said, “Any group with a Drow would probably want to be very careful.”
source_quote: “Any group with a Drow would probably want to be very careful. Everybody’s been on edge since the Ember Vanguard killed several members of the Derro High Council.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin muttered, “We killed several members of the high council?”
source_quote: Thorin mutters, “We killed several members of the high council?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin heard Gartokkar warn them about the Deepking’s agents.
source_quote: I heard the Deepking’s agents are everywhere, looking for a mercenary band so fierce that the Stone Guards are afraid to face them head-on.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin heard Gartokkar say, “Be careful. The Derro are on edge, and the Stone Guard are on edge.”
source_quote: Be careful. The Derro are on edge, and the Stone Guard are on edge. Everyone is worried something is going to happen, and some want it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum found the Duergar’s belief that dragon scale color determines evilness annoying.
source_quote: Grygum finds the tiresome confusion among the masses that the evil of dragons is a function of scale pigmentation to be very annoying

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, “I don’t know who these guys are, and given how fearsome they look, we would like to get back into town as quickly as possible.”
source_quote: I don’t know who these guys are, and given how fearsome they look, we would like to get back into town as quickly as possible.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, “I am a cleric of the Platinum Dragon. I know much about metallic dragons. But this is a chromatic dragon, and I know very little other than it will become evil.”
source_quote: I am a cleric of the Platinum Dragon. I know much about metallic dragons. But this is a chromatic dragon, and I know very little other than it will become evil.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked Gartokkar, “I don’t know what kind of deal we made or who we made it with!”
source_quote: I nod my head and say, “I don’t know what kind of deal we made or who we made it with!”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin found a note from the Gray Ghosts instructing them to stalk and strike the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: Stalk them relentlessly. Let the city itself become their cage. Strike from the shadows. Use invisibility, illusions, and sudden, whispered strikes. Leave paranoia in their wake. Allow no escape, no peace. Recover The Egg. It belongs to the Gray Ghosts.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin heard the Derro say, “The Grey Ghosts will have their revenge for the murder of the High Council.”
source_quote: They announce that the Grey Ghosts will have their revenge for the murder of the High Council.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin heard Gartokkar say, “I know of no such place [to the surface]. I do not know if such a place even exists.”
source_quote: I know of no such place. I do not know if such a place even exists. And I would not know what to do with a world that had no stone over my head.

fact: Zalthir saw the Duergar guard say, “Your business?”
source_quote: a Duergar guard materializes and asks, “Your business?”
